hero.title: Time2Go
hero.lead: Time2Go is a modern recruitment and flexible hiring platform for hospitality and services in Moldova.

features.title: Why Time2Go?
features.subtitle: The platform that turns recruitment and hiring into fast, digital and efficient processes.
features.pay48Desc: Get your salary fast, without long waits or bureaucracy.
features.digitalDesc: Everything happens online, from application to payment.
features.matchingDesc: Find jobs that match your skills perfectly.
features.flexDesc: Work when, where and as much as you want.

howItWorks.title: How Time2Go works
howItWorks.lead: The process is simple and fast. In minutes you can create a profile, apply for jobs and start working.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Add your skills, experience and preferences.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Browse and apply for jobs that fit you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Accept the job, work and get paid in 48h.

testimonials.title: What our users say
testimonials.subtitle: Thousands of people already use Time2Go for flexible jobs
testimonials.t1: Time2Go changed my life! I can work when I want and get paid fast. Perfect for students!
testimonials.t2: As an employer, Time2Go helped me find qualified staff quickly with no hidden costs. Recommended!
testimonials.t3: The platform is intuitive and easy to use. I found part-time jobs that fit my schedule perfectly.

forWho.title: Who is Time2Go for?
forWho.subtitle: Whether you're looking for flexible jobs or qualified staff, we've got you.
forWho.staffDesc: Students, freelancers or anyone who wants to work flexibly. Create a profile, apply for jobs and get paid in 48h.
forWho.employerDesc: Restaurants, hotels, events. Post openings, find vetted people and pay fast, no bureaucracy.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.lead: Join thousands already using Time2Go for flexible jobs and fast recruitment.

about.title: What is Time2Go
about.lead: Time2Go is a modern matching solution between labour demand and supply, using digital technology instead of traditional recruitment agencies. The platform is fully digital and free for users, both job seekers and employers.
about.smartProfileDesc: Create a profile and highlight your skills and experience.
about.flexJobsDesc: Ideal for students, part-time or occasional work.
about.zeroBurocracyDesc: Find suitable offers without long interviews or paperwork.

howItWorksPage.title: How it works
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: Add your skills, experience and schedule preferences.
howItWorksPage.step2Desc: Search for roles that match your location and skills.
howItWorksPage.step3Desc: Accept the project, work and get paid fast.

employers.title: For employers
employers.lead: Time2Go allows companies to post jobs and find qualified staff quickly and efficiently. You can test workers for a few hours and keep the good ones at no extra cost.
employers.benefitsLead: Publish your listing, choose candidates and complete the process digitally.

appPage.title: App and usage
appPage.lead: There is also a Time2Go mobile app for iOS and Android where users can manage jobs, schedules and pay through a simple interface.
